payload.title: The judgment sampler excludes on (run_id, finding_id) and never dedupes by finding fingerprint or drops groups already dispatched, so repeated nightly rows of one finding fill the per-tool sample slots and the fan-out then skips them as already dispatched
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1847-1850 (existing feedback is keyed on (run_id, finding_id), so a later run's row of the same finding is not excluded)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1863-1883 (every row in the 168 h window becomes a candidate; the fingerprint is tested only against promoted and false-positive settled sets)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1983-1994 (stratified selection pops rows per rule with no distinct-fingerprint pick)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:2003-2013 (the uncertainty ranking sorts rows by belief score and cuts to sample_size, so one hot finding can take every slot)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:85-100 (the judgment group is keyed on the run-independent fingerprint)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:504-509 (a seat whose (group, agent) is already dispatched or judged is skipped after the sampler spent the slot on it)
payload.rule_violated: Y2 (ORPHAN-704) intent stated in judge_fanout._group_id: a finding is asked once, cross-night; sample slots belong to findings that can mint a seat.
payload.notes: Seven findings re-recorded on seven nightly runs give 49 candidates; with one belief-hot finding the five slots hold five rows of one fingerprint, and a finding already in flight re-occupies the sample every night until it is promoted or settled. The fan-out mints nothing for those slots (already_dispatched), so at most a handful of distinct findings per tool per night reach the judges and the rest of the backlog is never drawn. The audit reproduced this on a snapshot of 602f2e17d1. Close condition: Reduce candidates to the newest row per finding_fingerprint and drop fingerprints whose judgment group already has a minted request or an ai_judge row before selection. Tests: seven fingerprints x seven nightly rows give a sample of five holding five distinct fingerprints, and an in-flight group is not drawn; both red today. Plan row: none named by the audit (new package: sampler and judge-input contract). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
